subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: After the final head is refreshed and macos-swift passes, must this update also pass signed packaged-app smoke for Sparkle updater activation and Peekaboo bridge/computer-action startup?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-compatible, but the largest upstream update changes permission-sensitive automation and bridge code, while Sparkle changes packaged updater activation behavior that compilation alone does not fully exercise.

options.title: Require packaged smoke
options.body: Verify updater activation and representative Peekaboo bridge/computer-action startup in a correctly signed packaged app before merge.

options.title: Accept exact-head CI
options.body: Merge after refreshed macOS and security checks pass while explicitly accepting the remaining packaged-runtime uncertainty.

options.title: Split runtime-sensitive updates
options.body: Replace the grouped bump with separate Sparkle and Peekaboo PRs for isolated proof and rollback.

recommendation.title: Require packaged smoke
recommendation.body: Verify updater activation and representative Peekaboo bridge/computer-action startup in a correctly signed packaged app before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent macOS work and ownership of Peekaboo make him the strongest available owner for the packaged-runtime proof standard.
